items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School/Agency Master Contract 2025/26 by and between the District and The Stepping Stones Group, San Jose, CA, for the latter to provide Special Education services, stated in Agreement, required by a student’s Individualized Education Program, by decreasing the amount by $3,500,000.00, reducing the not to exceed amount of the Agreement from $7,500,000.00 to $3,500,000.00, for the unchanged period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.

attachments.name: 26-0103 Grant Agreement - Oakland Public Education Fund - American Institutes of Research (AIR) - Research, Assessment, and Data Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts a $4,750 American Institutes of Research grant for Computer Science enrollment data
enrichment.summary: The district, through the Oakland Public Education Fund, is accepting a $4,750 grant from the American Institutes of Research (AIR) in exchange for providing OUSD Computer Science enrollment data for a case study. The grant period was September 18 to December 30, 2025, so it began and ended before this approval.
